channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Mensagens revelam que Lulinha e Roberta Luchsinger mantinham núcleo de atuação e projetavam ganhos milionários com o poder público
item.description: Messages released by Veja magazine suggest that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha), Roberta Luchsinger, and Fernando Bittar formed a core group to influence public contracts, particularly within the Ministry of Health. The Federal Police identified this trio as a coordinated structure aimed at advancing private interests before federal agencies, with alleged direct influence attempts on the federal government.

item.title: Haddad defende tornozeleira eletrônica para agressores de mulheres e diz que eles devem arcar com custo
item.description: Fernando Haddad advocated for electronic ankle bracelets for female abusers released during legal proceedings, suggesting they should cover the costs. He also supported applying the law to Supreme Court justices but warned against politicizing potential impeachment processes. The statement was made during a walk in Capão Redondo, São Paulo.

item.title: Flávio: Vamos ter que discutir a quantidade de etanol na gasolina; a gasolina virou etanol
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, PL candidate for president, criticized the government's increase in ethanol content in gasoline, claiming that gasoline has 'turned into ethanol'. He highlighted concerns over the federal energy policy.

item.title: PGR: PF não apontou negócio fechado entre governo e Careca do INSS
item.description: The PGR stated that no evidence was found of a deal between businessman Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes ('Careca do INSS') and the Public Power, despite investigating alleged lobbying by Roberta Luchsinger and Fábio Luís Lula da Silva. The agency requested the case be transferred to first-instance courts, citing no concrete involvement of STF-tried authorities.

item.title: Caiado critica Lula e Flávio e diz que não tem "nada para esconder"
item.description: Candidate Ronaldo Caiado criticized Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, claiming they avoid debates because they have 'much to hide'. He emphasized having no involvement in irregularities and defended the moral authority of presidential candidates.

item.title: Lulinha reclamou de Kalil usar seu nome em negócio na Telebras
item.description: Messages obtained by the Federal Police reveal that Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, complained about Kalil Bittar using his name to close a deal with Telebras. The case is part of an investigation pointing to corruption and influence peddling involving federal agencies and the president's son as a hidden broker of million-dollar contracts.

item.title: Deputado do PL se envolve em tumulto na UFBA; universidade aciona PF
item.description: State Congressman Diego Castro (PL) sparked a confrontation at UFBA while removing pro-Lula and Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues stickers, leading to clashes with students and allegations of assault. The university filed a police report and contacted the Federal Police, amid growing political pressure over Castro's actions.

item.title: TSE oficializa tempo de propaganda de candidatos; Lula lidera
item.description: The TSE set the free electoral advertising times for the 2026 elections, with Lula leading at 5 minutes and 31 seconds per slot. Flávio Bolsonaro follows with 4 minutes and 20 seconds, forming a dominant duo. Only a few candidates met the minimum criteria for advertising access, excluding figures like Zema.

item.title: Lula promete entregar transposição do São Francisco até dezembro
item.description: During the electoral moratorium, President Lula pledged to complete the São Francisco River transposition by December 2026, calling it the world’s largest hydraulic project. The ongoing project, started in 2007, will benefit 15 million northeasterners, though the legality of his speech during the campaign period remains subject to electoral court scrutiny.

item.title: Lula diz que governo Bolsonaro foi construído sobre “processo de mentira”
item.description: Lula criticized the Bolsonaro administration, claiming it was built on a 'lie process' during a campaign event in Rio Grande do Norte. He emphasized the country's disarray upon his return to government.

item.title: Flávio diz estar chateado com ataques de candidatos de centro-direita e cobra críticas a Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro expressed dissatisfaction with center-right candidates attacking his pre-campaign instead of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, claiming he has the people and God on his side. During a live stream, he emphasized supporting other right-wing candidates but criticized figures like Romeu Zema and Ronaldo Caiado for opposing his bid, while also attacking Lula over his son Lulinha's investigation.

item.title: Com um filho como Lulinha, quem precisa de adversários?
item.description: Three federal police investigations involving Lula's son Fábio Luiz and lobbyist Roberta Luchinger deepen corruption suspicions in the INSS case, pressuring the PF, PGR, and STF, while indirectly benefiting Flávio Bolsonaro. The scandal reveals possible illegal negotiations tied to the Lula government, increasing political polarization and mud-slinging ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: O que muda na Lei Maria da Penha com decisão do STF
item.description: The STF expanded the scope of the Maria da Penha Law by ruling that women can request protective measures even when the aggressor is a stranger without family ties. The ruling covers community, workplace, institutional, or electoral violence, requiring judges to evaluate such cases. Justice Edson Fachin led the decision.

item.title: Caiado ironiza Flávio por não divulgar contas de “Dark Horse”
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado mocked Flávio Bolsonaro for failing to publish the accounting for 'Dark Horse', a biopic of Jair Bolsonaro, after unkept promises to disclose expenses. Flávio claimed the documents were filed in a court case and later leaked, calling the matter 'closed'. The case involves allegations of $24 million funding arranged with Daniel Vorcaro.

item.title: Em 2024, Roberta Luchsinger projetou ganhos de R$ 100 milhões em esquema
item.description: The Federal Police opened an investigation into Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, son of President Lula, on suspicion of corruption and influence peddling. Intercepted communications reveal lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger projecting R$100 million in gains in 2024 through schemes involving the federal government. Three inquiries were launched to examine the duo's dealings with agencies such as the Ministry of Health and Dataprev.

item.title: Mensagens expõem parceria de Lulinha com lobista e revelam grupo de WhatsApp para debater negócios: ‘Vai com tudo’, diz filho do presidente
item.description: Messages obtained by the Federal Police reveal that Fábio Lulinha, son of President Lula, had a partnership with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger to broker deals with the federal government, including access to the Ministry of Health. The case, investigated for suspected influence peddling, shows chats in a WhatsApp group called 'Musaranhos', where the trio discussed negotiations. The PF concludes there was a hidden partnership between Lulinha, Luchsinger, and Fernando Bittar to mediate private interests with public officials.

item.title: Lula anuncia supercomputador: “Nem chinês nem americano é melhor”
item.description: President Lula announced a national AI supercomputer in Rio Grande do Norte, with a R$ 1.6 billion investment, to position Brazil in the global tech race. The project, part of the Brazilian AI Plan, aims to reduce foreign dependency, retain talent, and decentralize the country's tech infrastructure.

item.title: Lula faz piada e diz que não quer “um coreano” em sonda da Petrobras
item.description: Lula joked about not wanting 'a Korean' in a Petrobras drill, but emphasized advances in deepwater oil exploration and supported using oil revenues to fund renewable energy. He announced a R$ 2.5 billion investment in artificial intelligence, including a 7.2 exaflop supercomputer, to boost Brazil's technological sovereignty.

item.title: Nunes Marques desempata, e TSE libera candidatura de Crivella ao Senado
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) suspended Marcelo Crivella's ineligibility, allowing his Senate candidacy. The tie-breaking vote was cast by President Kassio Nunes Marques, aligning with rapporteur André Mendonça. Crivella had been ineligible since 2024 due to political and economic power abuse in the 2020 elections.

item.title: PF não aponta “conclusão de negócio” do Careca do INSS com governo, diz PGR
item.description: The PGR informed the STF that the actions of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and Lulinha to favor the INSS Scammer did not result in closed deals with the federal government.

item.title: Dirceu diz que casos de Lulinha e Marcola não comprometem Lula
item.description: José Dirceu stated that the investigations into Lulinha and Marcola do not compromise Lula's campaign, emphasizing they must answer like any citizen. He criticized leaks and defended due process.

item.title: Crise na Casas Bahia vira gancho para críticas ao governo Lula na disputa eleitoral
item.description: The financial crisis at Casas Bahia, which filed for judicial recovery claiming debts of R$ 17.3 billion, has become a talking point in the 2026 Brazilian electoral race. The situation is being used by opposition candidates as ammunition to criticize Lula's (PT) administration.

item.title: Tanto faz roubar com a mão esquerda ou direita, é ladrão, diz Caiado
item.description: PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado stated that "it doesn't matter if you steal with the left hand or the right hand, you're still a thief," referring to President Lula (PT) and his opponent Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The remarks were made on Thursday the 20th during a SBT News interview. The statement reflects Caiado's strategy of attacking both sides of the political spectrum.

item.title: Amiga de Lulinha diz em mensagem que Lula ofereceu cargo a ela, diz revista
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, a friend of Lulinha, told the PF that Lula asked her 'where she wanted to stay,' allegedly offering a government position. The revelation, from messages obtained by the police, was reported by Veja magazine amid her investigation for influence trafficking.

item.title: Mendonça manda remover vídeo com deepfake de Flávio Bolsonaro ao lado de Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: TSE minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of a deepfake video linking Flávio Bolsonaro to former banker Daniel Vorcaro, following a request by the PL party. He ruled that AI was used to create nonexistent scenarios disguised as real events, violating electoral transparency rules.

item.title: Dirceu critica juros e diz que dívida pública do Brasil “é pequena”
item.description: José Dirceu criticized high interest rates and argued that Brazil's public debt is small, attributing fiscal issues to the nominal deficit rather than the primary one. He proposed cutting tax breaks to achieve a surplus and questioned the 14% Selic rate as a political choice.

item.title: TSE proíbe Marçal de ir a debates e barra recursos do Fundo Eleitoral
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) barred candidate Pablo Marçal from participating in electoral debates, accessing radio and TV time, and using funds from the Electoral Fund. The precautionary measure was taken due to his continued ineligibility by the Regional Electoral Court of São Paulo and disputes over his party registration.

item.title: TSE libera Marcelo Crivella para concorrer nas eleições
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) ruled 4-3 to suspend the ineligibility of Marcelo Crivella, former mayor of Rio de Janeiro convicted for abuse of power in the 'QG da Propina' scheme. The decision, allowing his Senate candidacy, came after judicial review challenging the sentence, with divided votes among justices. The injunction was granted by rapporteur André Mendonça, who argued the irregularities related to the 2016 election, not 2020.

item.title: Zema critica regulamentação do trabalho por app sugerida pelo governo e defende negociação entre entregadores e empresas
item.description: Romeu Zema criticized the federal regulation proposal for app-based workers and advocates direct negotiation between delivery workers and companies, including a minimum per-route fare. He rejects state intervention and proposes an alternative hourly work model, warning about family debt under the current system.

item.title: Lobista amiga de Lulinha mandava motorista entregar dinheiro em malas
item.description: Federal Police investigation reveals that lobbyist Roberta Moreira Luchsinger instructed her driver to deliver cash in suitcases to Lulinha and businessman Fernando Bittar, raising suspicions of influence trafficking and corruption. Messages indicate travel payments and offshore financial movements, while Lulinha denies involvement in public administration dealings.

item.title: “Fernando, Lulinha e eu somos uma coisa só”, disse lobista
item.description: Messages from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger suggest a suspected alliance between her, Lulinha (son of President Lula), and Fernando Bittar, hinting at joint involvement in government-related businesses. The chats imply Lulinha had influence over the group's decisions without direct negotiation, with alleged actions in the Ministry of Health and Dataprev. Lulinha's defense team called the disclosures a criminal leak lacking concrete evidence.

item.title: Alckmin estreia na campanha de Haddad neste sábado em agenda sobre educação
item.description: Vice President Geraldo Alckmin joins Fernando Haddad's São Paulo campaign, participating in the education govemment plan launch. Alckmin commits to weekend and Friday activities in the state, supporting Haddad and Lula campaigns with regional outreach and meetings with mayors and entrepreneurs.

item.title: ‘Lula chamou e perguntou’: Mensagens de lobista amiga de Lulinha citam conversa com presidente
item.description: Messages from lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, obtained by the PF, indicate she spoke directly with President Lula. The exchanges are part of STF proceedings examining the movement of businesspeople and consultants in federal bodies. The case revives debates about political influence and lobbying in government.

item.title: Lobista diz que Lulinha “só entra em campo quando precisa”
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger stated in PF-intercepted messages that Lulinha "only enters the field when necessary" to preserve himself in government negotiations. The investigation reveals a scheme of private interest mediation, including a billion-real cannabis oil deal attempt at the Health Ministry, with personal expense payments to a former INSS chief of staff.

item.title: TSE derruba inelegibilidade de Crivella com voto de Nunes Marques
item.description: The TSE voted 4 to 3 to suspend Marcelo Crivella's ineligibility in the 'QG da Propina' case, with a tie-breaking vote from president Kassio Nunes Marques. The ruling allows the former Rio mayor to resume his Senate candidacy for the Republicans.

item.title: Lula: 'Na política, quando você erra uma vez, você é destruído'
item.description: President Lula publicly defended Governor Fátima Bezerra (PT-RN), who dropped her Senate bid after disputes with her vice governor, during an event in Natal. Lula stated that in politics, a single mistake can destroy one's public image. The remarks were made at the Augusto Severo Science and Technology Park.

item.title: TRE-SP reverte decisão e libera vídeo com Tarcísio como boneco Chucky
item.description: São Paulo's Regional Electoral Court (TRE-SP) unanimously reversed a lower-court ruling that had ordered state deputy Emídio de Souza (PT) to take down an AI-generated video depicting Governor Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicans) as the Chucky doll, classifying it as satire without an explicit vote appeal. Souza had initially been fined R$10,000, and Tarcísio's campaign said it will appeal the collegiate decision.

item.title: Mendonça manda retirar vídeo que associa Flávio Bolsonaro a Vorcaro e diz que sátira não afasta proibição de deepfake
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça ordered the removal of a deepfake video associating Flávio Bolsonaro with Daniel Vorcaro. The ruling establishes that satirical intent does not override electoral prohibitions on synthetic media manipulated to harm candidacies.

item.title: Caiado defende ampliar prerrogativa dos governadores na segurança pública: 'legislar em alguns crimes'
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a presidential candidate, stated he intends to expand governors' prerogatives in public security, allowing states to legislate on specific crimes within their territories. He pledged to create a Ministry of Public Security and provide support in intelligence, Coaf, and the Federal Revenue to fight organized crime, criticizing the Lula administration for interfering in state autonomy. He also advocated for a regulatory framework on artificial intelligence and legislation on rare earths to diversify Brazilian exports.

item.title: Flávio diz que Nikolas tem perfil pra ser presidente da República
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated that federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL) has the profile to become President of the Republic someday. The comment was made during an interview granted to the lawmaker on his YouTube channel.

item.title: Em mensagem, Luchsinger sugere pagar por mudança de Lulinha para Madri
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger suggested, in messages obtained by magazine Veja, that she paid for President Lula's son Fábio Luís da Silva to leave Brazil during PF investigations. Her defense declined to comment.

item.title: Há tentativa de blindagem, diz ex-presidente da CPMI do INSS sobre Lulinha
item.description: Senator Carlos Viana (PSD-MG), former president of the CPMI on INSS, stated there is an attempt to shield the case investigating the alleged influence peddling involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, son of President Lula. Viana criticized the Attorney General's Office (PGR) for requesting the investigation be moved to the first instance and Senate President Davi Alcolumbre for not extending the CPMI, advocating for a new parliamentary inquiry committee. He also reported pressure from the government's allies to prevent the gathering of signatures for the new CPI.

item.title: Lobista Roberta Luchsinger diz que Lula lhe ofereceu cargo no governo
item.description: Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger stated in intercepted messages that she declined a government position offered by Lula to focus on business with his son, Lulinha. The Federal Police are investigating alleged corruption and influence peddling involving federal agencies and the president.

item.title: PSOL vai ao TSE contra Renan Santos por repetir ‘campeonatos de cortes’ que tornou Marçal inelegível
item.description: PSOL asked the TSE to investigate Renan Santos for promoting 'cutting competitions' similar to those that made Pablo Marçal ineligible in 2024, accusing him of economic power abuse. The strategy reportedly involved indirect payment to content creators through platform monetization, which is prohibited by electoral law.

item.title: Ao lado de Tarcísio, Flávio fala em ser 'presidente de transição'
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro attended a business event in Mooca alongside Governor Tarcísio de Freitas and Mayor Ricardo Nunes. In his speech, Flávio suggested he would accept being a 'transition president' if elected in 2026, signaling willingness to serve only one term. Tarcísio criticized the economic situation citing the Casas Bahia case and urged votes for allies including Flávio.

item.title: Lobista cobrou Lulinha para “se mexer” por negócio de R$ 1 bilhão
item.description: Brazil's Federal Police is investigating Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, known as Lulinha, over his alleged involvement in a BRL 1 billion deal with the Ministry of Health regarding cannabidiol-based medications. According to Veja magazine, lobbyist Antônio Carlos Camilo Antunes, nicknamed Careca do INSS, orchestrated the deal with the help of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger, who pressured Lulinha to act on regulation matters. Lulinha's defense denied the accusations, claiming the leaks aim to influence the electoral process.

item.title: PF diz que Lulinha atuava com baixa exposição em contratos milionários
item.description: The Federal Police concluded that Lulinha operated with low visibility but was identified as a highly relevant figure in multimillion-dollar federal contracts. The investigation indicates signs of corruption and influence peddling involving the Ministry of Health and a coordinated group with lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger and Fernando Bittar.

item.title: Governo Lula chamará mercado para discutir Nuvem Brasileira
item.description: The Lula administration announced the Brazilian Cloud, a public-private partnership for sovereign data infrastructure involving MGI, ABDI, Serpro, and BNDES. The package includes a R$1 billion AI supercomputer in Rio Grande do Norte, cooperation with Chinese firms for Portuguese-language AI models, and an Algorithmic Transparency Center at UFMG.

item.title: Lula critica governo Bolsonaro em estreia no Nordeste: 'Era brincadeira na internet, falar mal e provocar os outros'
item.description: Lula criticized the Bolsonaro administration during a campaign event in Rio Grande do Norte, accusing the previous government of building a country based on lies and instability. He highlighted the country's reconstruction and announced a R$ 1.06 billion investment in supercomputers and AI for technological sovereignty.

item.title: Faculdades privadas dizem que Caiado revela desconhecimento sobre cursos de Medicina
item.description: Abmes stated that PSD presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado demonstrates ignorance regarding medical education in Brazil. The association advocates for public policies ensuring quality and regulation in higher education, particularly in courses such as Medicine.
